LESSON: KUSOMA 2.2.1 KUSOMA KWA KINA MATUMIZI YA KAMUSI

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: HUDUMA YA KWANZA Mada Mada Ndogo Matokeo Maalumu Yanayotarajiwa Shughuli za Ujif
Topic 2.2: Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Matumizi ya kamusi

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo ni somo la kusoma: Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Matumizi ya kamusi. Soma maelezo, fuata mifano iliyofanyiwa kazi, kisha fanya mazoezi.

SEHEMU 2: MALENGO

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. Explain the main ideas in Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Matumizi ya kamusi
2. Give Kenyan examples for Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Matumizi ya kamusi
3. Practise Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Matumizi ya kamusi at school and at home

SEHEMU 3: SOMO (MAELEZO NA MIFANO)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: KUSOMA 2.2.1 KUSOMA KWA KINA MATUMIZI YA KAMUSI
This lesson teaches Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Matumizi ya kamusi for Grade 5 KISWAHILI.

STUDY STEPS
1. Explain the main ideas in Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Matumizi ya kamusi
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. Give Kenyan examples for Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Matumizi ya kamusi
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. Practise Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Matumizi ya kamusi at school and at home
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO YA HARAKA

Example 1: Describe Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Matumizi ya kamusi using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: MAZOEZI

1. Underline the key ideas about Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Matumizi ya kamusi above.
2. Explain Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Matumizi ya kamusi to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Matumizi ya kamusi.

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA NYUMBANI

1. Write five sentences about Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Matumizi ya kamusi with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Matumizi ya kamusi important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. Explain the main ideas in Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Matumizi ya kamusi
2. Give Kenyan examples for Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Matumizi ya kamusi
3. Practise Kusoma 2.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Matumizi ya kamusi at school and at home

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.
